name: telco-churn-analysis
description: Telco customer churn analysis. What drives churn, what it costs, and a model that scores it, with a live app.

paragraphs: An end-to-end churn analysis on the IBM Telco sample dataset: exploratory analysis in notebooks, two models trained and compared on a held-out test set, a short findings write-up for a business reader, and a Streamlit app that scores a customer profile against the shipped model. Churn is 26.5 percent overall, concentrated in first-year, month-to-month accounts, and the logistic regression that ships scores 0.846 ROC AUC on customers it never saw in training.
Live app: (free tier, the first request after idle can take a minute)
